executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection appeared in at least one AI answer for 50% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection appeared 28.6% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection in the hotel options surfaced.

The clearest strength in this period is often placed near the top when ai ranks hotels. See the summary at left for the supporting numbers. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection appeared in the Top 3 69.7% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: The Mayflower Hotel, Autograph Collection reaches many monitored demand scenarios, but consideration consistency is the binding constraint.
sections.keyInsight: Scenario Presence is 50% while AI Consideration is 28.6%. The hotel is therefore relevant across a wide share of monitored traveler needs, yet it is not carried into individual answers nearly as consistently. Softness concentrates in Adventure & Experiences versus stronger Wellness. Hotel Washington often fills absences in those weaker contexts. That contrast is more important than either metric alone.
sections.whyItMatters: Broad scenario reach without consistent answer-level inclusion means the hotel is known in the demand set but not reliably carried into traveler-facing answers. Management attention should start with consistency of representation, not with assuming the hotel needs an entirely new competitive set.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on consistency of representation for Adventure & Experiences. Confirm priority sources present the same use cases and attributes that appear in scenarios where the hotel is absent, and close gaps that repeatedly coincide with answer-level misses.
sections.whatToReview: Compare high-presence versus low-consideration scenarios and inspect which sources and attributes appear when the hotel is missing. Use that evidence pack before changing channel strategy.
